name: Halmaj (Hungary)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Halmaj: a white and red shield with a fish and a heart, with a yellow shell crest, supported by two yellow griffins, above a scroll inscribed HALMAJ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Halmaj arms with crest, supporters and scroll
